name: Feel First: Interactive Sensory Musical Experience by ArtBeat - Launch of the Nav Brand- textiles by people with special needs
description: What if you could feel music before you heard it? Join us for Feel First – A Sound Experiment, an interactive, sensory-friendly experience where sound, rhythm and silence become tools to explore emotions, connection and communication. Whether you're a parent, educator, therapist, artist, or simply curious, this immersive session invites you to discover how music can shape the way we feel, connect and respond. Open to people of all ages | Inclusive | Registration not required  The roads leading up to Sabha are undergoing maintenance, please plan to arrive early and avail of public transport. name: Musical Evening with Kayaka - Launch of NAV by Nav Prabhuthi Trust

name: The Art of Intimacy Workshop - Your Path to an Ecstatic Intimate Life
Citizen Cafe - Discover the Citizen in You
description: We, The People Abhiyan (WTPA) invites you to cover our Citizen Cafe: Living the Constitution, an experiential workshop exploring the Preamble to the Constitution of India and its relevance to our everyday life. The Constitution of India is the fundamental source of rights and welfare guarantees, government accountability, and responsibilities for all citizens. It is intimately linked with our daily lives and provides pathways for our progress. Our development – individual and collective – is determined by our ability to understand and practice the letter and spirit of the Constitution and use it to address issues that concern us. The workshop will take participants through a deep dive into the Preamble, the single page that defines the vision and values of the Constitution using discussion and shared storytelling to examine how these values translate into practice at home, at work, and in community life. It is part of WTPA's ongoing effort to build a learning network of active and engaged citizens. Since 2014, WTPA has facilitated over 5,000 such workshops across India, working to make constitutional literacy accessible and lived. About the facilitator: The session will be facilitated by Vinita Gursahani Singh, Managing Trustee of We, The People Abhiyan. She has personally facilitated over 1,000 workshops nationally and is a public speaker and writer. Entry: Free (participants may purchase their own refreshments at the venue) We would be glad to have you join us and would welcome coverage of the session.
